shipping_rates_days_valid.name: shipping_rates_days_valid
shipping_rates_days_valid.value:
("shipping_rates"."min_days" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."min_days" >= 0)
          AND ("shipping_rates"."max_days" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."min_days" IS NULL OR "shipping_rates"."max_days" >= "shipping_rates"."min_days")

products_season_months_valid.name: products_season_months_valid
products_season_months_valid.value:
("products"."season_start_month" IS NULL OR "products"."season_start_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
          AND ("products"."season_end_month" IS NULL OR "products"."season_end_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
